QuestInfo.1: #b#p3001008##k asks you to obtain #b50 #t4033410##k so the soldiers can eat. They can be obtained from #r#o2400103##k monsters over at #b#m401030000##k.\n

0.0: Sorry to keep you waiting. Some of the guys were trying to tell me Angelic Buster had a mole on her left knee and I had to show them all of my research. Can you believe that? She totally does not have a mole. Oh, I'm #b#p3001008##k, by the way. I'm the quartermaster.
0.1: Hopefully you can tell me apart from my twin bro over there, #b#p3001009##k. We both chopped off one of our horns to help people tell us apart, but it doesn't seem to help.
0.2: I'm sure you already know, but a lot of the soldiers are near starving. We just can't get enough food through. I sure hope Angelic Buster isn't getting hungry. She doesn't deserve to ever be hungry.
0.3: Do you think maybe you can get some meat for us? There's a monster called a #r#o2400103##k nearby that makes a killer steak. I think we need about #b50#k of them to feed everybody.\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.0: That's great. I'll just wait here.

no.0: You're not gonna go eat all of them yourself, are you?

yes.0: Finally, I can stop boiling old boots. The soldiers are going to flip when they see this. #b#p3001001##k was looking for, by the way.

item.0: We just need about #b50 #t4033410##k items from the #r#o2400103##k monsters around the #b#m401030000##k.
